description: This file defines the AWSAgentCoreProcessor class, a Python class that manages invoking Amazon Bedrock AgentCore agents, handling streaming responses, and transforming context and responses into payloads and output frames within a larger AI processing framework.

classes.name: AWSAgentCoreProcessor
classes.description: A processor class that manages invoking Amazon Bedrock AgentCore agents, streaming responses, and converting context and responses into frames for further processing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the AWSAgentCoreProcessor with AWS credentials, agent ARN, and optional transformers for payload creation and response parsing.

methods.name: _close_output_response_after_timeout
methods.description: Closes the output response frame after a timeout if no new text frames arrive.

methods.name: _push_text_frame
methods.description: Pushes a text frame while managing start and end frames for the response stream.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, invokes the AWS AgentCore, and handles streaming responses, transforming them into text frames.
